name: Supernatural Slayer
body:
You possess great skill in killing supernatural entities.

Prerequisites: Combat Reflexes, Shield Against the Supernatural

Prerequisites: Creatures that use supernatural abilities while in your threatened area provoke attacks of opportunity from you.

Normal: Supernatural abilities do not provoke attacks of opportunity.
